instructions.text: Simmer bacon in 1½ quarts of water for 10 minutes. Drain and dry.
Saute bacon in 1 T. oil over moderate heat to brown lightly. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside in a dutch oven.
Dry the beef in paper towels.
Add 1 T. oil to bacon grease and brown beef and add to dutch oven.
In same fat, brown carrot and onions and add to dutch oven.
Add 1 tsp. salt, ¼ tsp. pepper and 2 T. flour to dutch oven and toss.
Set in oven for 4 minutes. Toss meat again and return to oven for 4 more minutes. Lower oven to 325 degrees.
Stir in 3 cups wine and enough beef stock so that meat is barely covered. Add tomato paste, garlic, herbs. Bring to simmer on top of the stove.
Cover and set in lower ⅓ of oven and simmer for 3 hours or until beef is tender.
While beef is cooking, add 1½ T. butter and 1½ T. oil to skillet over moderate heat. When it is bubbling, add pearl onions and saute for 10 minutes.
Pour in ½ cup beef stock and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 40 to 50 minutes. Liquid should have evaporated.

Place another skillet over high heat with 2 T. butter and 1 T. oil. As soon as butter foam has begun to form, add mushrooms. Toss and shake pan for 4 to 5 minutes. As soon as they have browned lightly, remove from heat. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Add pearl onions and mushrooms to beef and serve over boiled potatoes.

Beef Bourguignon
 
Save Print
Author: Julia Childs
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 6 Ounce(s) cut into 1" chunks bacon
  • 4 Tablespoon(s) olive oil
  • 3 Pound(s) beef stew meat
  • 1 carrot, chopped
  • 1 white onion, thinly sliced
  • 1 Teaspoon(s) salt
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) pepper
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) flour
  • 3 Cup(s) red wine
  • 3 Cup(s) beef stock
  • 1 Tablespoon(s) tomato paste
  • 2 Clove(s) garlic, minced
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) chopped fresh thyme or, ¼ teaspoon crumbled, dried thyme
  • 1 bay leaves
  • 24 pearl onions
  • 1 Pound(s) button mushrooms, trimmed and quartered
Instructions
  1. Simmer bacon in 1½ quarts of water for 10 minutes. Drain and dry.
  2. Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
  3. Saute bacon in 1 T. oil over moderate heat to brown lightly. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside in a dutch oven.
  4. Dry the beef in paper towels.
  5. Add 1 T. oil to bacon grease and brown beef and add to dutch oven.
  6. In same fat, brown carrot and onions and add to dutch oven.
  7. Add 1 tsp. salt, ¼ tsp. pepper and 2 T. flour to dutch oven and toss.
  8. Set in oven for 4 minutes. Toss meat again and return to oven for 4 more minutes. Lower oven to 325 degrees.
  9. Stir in 3 cups wine and enough beef stock so that meat is barely covered. Add tomato paste, garlic, herbs. Bring to simmer on top of the stove.
  10. Cover and set in lower ⅓ of over and simmer fore 3 hours or until beef is tender.
  11. While beef is cooking, add 1½ T. butter and 1½ T. oil to skillet over moderate heat. When it is bubbling, add pearl onions and saute for 10 minutes.
  12. Pour in ½ cup beef stock and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 40 to 50 minutes. Liquid should have evaporated.
  13. Place another skillet over high heat with 2 T. butter and 1 T. oil. As soon as butter foam has begun to form, add mushrooms. Toss and shake pan for 4 to 5 minutes. As soon as they have browned lightly, remove from heat. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
  14. Add pearl onions and mushrooms to beef and serve over boiled potatoes.
